description: CARTA TECNICA COMUNALE - Canalette irrigue is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna - Sistema Informativo Territoriale (SIT). Carta tecnica comunale - Layer "canalette irrigue" (sistema di riferimento WGS84). Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Regioni e città. The portal shows 2,431 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
